sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You can expect a pleasant, comfortable day at the office, today, so says Ganesha. You will be carrying out your work cheerfully and effortlessly. You could, later in the evening, have a strong urge to go out for dinner with your family and friends. If that does happen, you’re certain to go for an after dinner movie, or an ice cream treat. The day promises you lots of fun and amusement.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: It may seem like everyone around you is happy and getting what they want while you're stuck in the trenches, Taurus. Don't compare yourself to other people and make judgments based on outside appearances. The truth of the matter is that they're most likely only looking at the immediate future and experiencing short-term pleasures. You, however, have your sights set on the long-term and will probably be much better off.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Your sense of balance may be upended this morning, dearest Taurus. The Cancer quarter Moon aligns with Venus rx, encouraging you to seek softness. Unfortunately, a tense square with Saturn threatens your ability to think clearly. Meanwhile, Mars and Pluto face off, which could cause you to lash out as emotions fluctuate. If you start to feel unlike yourself, adjust your behaviors and find a healthy outlet for blowing off steam.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Creative work will keep you relaxed. You will possess a considerable amount of money today, and with it there will be peace of mind. Give priorities to the needs of family members. Involve yourself to share their joy and sorrow to realize them that you care for them. Time to re-assess your strengths and your future plans. Your spouse is all in mood to surprise you with the ecstasy of love; help him/her. Time is absolutely free, but it is precious too. So, accomplish all your pending tasks today and relax tomorrow.
